title: LYA Job (durable execution state)
description: The automation spine (ADR-011). Must survive a restart: on boot, 'running' jobs are resumed or visibly failed - never silently dropped.

plan_id.description: Links to plan.schema.json; the plan_hash is what the owner approved.

goal.description: Human-readable restatement, for the UI and the audit log.

idempotency_key.description: Applied twice = written once. Required so a retry cannot double-execute (07-NEURAL-SCHEMA.md 7).

due_at.description: Set by the scheduler (L7 trigger), not polled every 30 s (S-10).

scope.description: What exactly was approved. Deviating from it re-escalates (ADR-002).

error.description: Failures are shown, never hidden (02-DATA-ROUTING.md: never claim saved when the write failed).
